hook: Claude Code can now hand off sessions to your phone or browser
what_it_is: A new /remote-control command bridges a running Claude Code terminal session to claude.ai/code, so you can start work on your laptop and continue or check on it from a browser or phone.
why_you: As a solo builder juggling Short Clips Studio, the kids' games, and Sengoku Campaign between OD consulting gigs, this lets you kick off a build in the morning and check progress or nudge Claude from your phone during a break, without opening a laptop.
prompt_to_try: In Claude Code, run /remote-control on my current Short Clips Studio session and tell me exactly how to open and control it from my phone browser.

hook: A team turned QA into a 'Council' of 8 specialized Claude subagents
what_it_is: OpenObserve built eight role-specific Claude Code subagents that split end-to-end test analysis, generation, and review into stages, each gated by a human check, running as slash commands defined in markdown files.
why_you: This is a concrete, buildable pattern for your QA-for-AI-SDLC thesis: instead of writing about quality leadership in the abstract, you could prototype a small 'council' of 2-3 subagents (e.g. test-planner, test-writer, reviewer) on one of your own repos and turn the experience into your next LinkedIn post.
prompt_to_try: Help me design a mini 'council' of 3 Claude Code subagents (test-planner, test-writer, test-reviewer) for my Hebrew geography game repo, each with a clear role and a human checkpoint between stages, and write the first subagent definition file.

hook: A library of ready-made QA subagents you can drop into any repo
what_it_is: VoltAgent's open-source collection offers over 100 specialized Claude Code subagents, including a dedicated qa-expert agent for test planning, coverage analysis, and quality metrics, packaged as copy-in markdown definitions.
why_you: Rather than writing a QA subagent from scratch, you can pull the qa-expert definition, adapt it to your Sengoku Campaign Godot project or the kids' games, and immediately have a repeatable review step to practice and document for your QA-leadership pivot.
prompt_to_try: Read this QA subagent structure I'm pasting below (from VoltAgent's qa-expert.md), then adapt it into a subagent tailored to reviewing my Godot 4 Sengoku Campaign prototype for bugs, balance issues, and missing edge cases.
